description: SvPasswordInput on its own in Svelte 5: a show and hide reveal toggle and an optional four-level strength meter, with a label, a hint, validation and localizable strings, plus the autocomplete attribute for password managers. It is the SvGrid password cell editor, standalone.

faq.question: How is strength calculated?
faq.answer: From length and the mix of lower case, upper case, digits and symbols, mapped to four levels shown as a bar with a label. showStrength turns the meter on.

faq.question: Can I translate the strings?
faq.answer: Yes. The messages prop overrides the reveal button label and the strength level names.

faq.question: Does the reveal toggle affect autofill?
faq.answer: No. The input keeps its autocomplete value, new-password here, so browsers and password managers treat it as a password field whether or not it is revealed.
